title: Outcome event data (PROPOSED)
description: PROPOSED. The "data" member of outcome.recorded: one measured or estimated result (recovered revenue, saved time, avoided cost). Derived from Vireek's value ledger (table `value_events`); no outcome event is emitted or exposed in the public API today. The producer-internal `source_feature` and account id are left out.

type.description: What kind of result this is.

amount.description: Whole units: cents for money, minutes for saved time.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. Required for money, null for time.

confidence.description: Whether the amount was observed or estimated.

method_note.description: How the amount was worked out, in plain words.

evidence_ref.description: Pointer to the record that proves it (producer-defined).

supersedes_ref.description: evidence_ref of an estimate this measured value replaces.
